description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.
After releasing Basic Attack 4, enter True Sight, lasting for 12s.

Mid-air Attack

Consume Stamina to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing Fusion DMG.
After releasing Mid-air Attack 4, enter True Sight, lasting for 12s.

Heavy Attack

Hold Basic Attack on the ground to perform an upward strike at the cost of Stamina, dealing Fusion DMG. Use Basic Attack within a certain time to release Mid-Air Attack 3.

Mid-air Heavy Attack

Shortly after holding Basic Attack in mid-air or using Basic Attack True Sight: Charge, use Basic Attack to perform a plunging attack at the cost of Stamina, dealing Fusion DMG. Use Basic Attack within a certain time to release Basic Attack 3.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Fusion DMG.
Setelah melepaskan Basic Attack 4, memasuki True Sight selama 12 dtk.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi Stamina untuk melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun di udara, memberikan Fusion DMG.
Setelah melepaskan Mid-air Attack 4, memasuki True Sight selama 12 dtk.

Heavy Attack

Tahan Basic Attack di darat untuk melakukan serangan ke atas dengan mengonsumsi Stamina, memberikan Fusion DMG. Gunakan Basic Attack dalam waktu tertentu untuk melepaskan Mid-Air Attack 3.

Mid-air Heavy Attack

Sesaat setelah menahan Basic Attack di udara atau menggunakan Basic Attack True Sight: Charge, gunakan Basic Attack untuk melakukan serangan menghunjam dengan mengonsumsi Stamina, memberikan Fusion DMG. Gunakan Basic Attack dalam waktu tertentu untuk melepaskan Basic Attack 3.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en:
True Sight: Capture

After releasing Resonance Skill, Changli dashes towards the enemy and enters True Sight, lasting for 12s. In the end, she releases a plunging attack, dealing Fusion DMG.
True Sight: Capture has 2 initial charges and holds up to 2 charges at maximum. The number of charges is replenished by 1 every 12s.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest

When in True Sight, if Changli uses Ground Basic Attack, she releases True Sight: Conquest, dashing towards the enemy and dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG. After releasing True Sight: Conquest, True Sight ends.

Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge

When in True Sight, if Changli jumps or uses Basic Attack in mid-air, she releases True Sight: Charge, dashing towards the enemy and dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG. After releasing True Sight: Charge, True Sight ends.
description.id:
True Sight: Capture

Setelah melepaskan Resonance Skill, Changli melesat ke arah musuh dan memasuki True Sight selama 12 dtk. Di akhir, ia melepaskan serangan menghunjam, memberikan Fusion DMG.
True Sight: Capture memiliki 2 charge awal dan menyimpan maksimal 2 charge. Jumlah charge bertambah 1 setiap 12 dtk.
Dapat dilakukan di udara.

Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest

Saat di True Sight, jika Changli menggunakan Basic Attack di darat, ia melepaskan True Sight: Conquest, melesat ke arah musuh dan memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG. Setelah True Sight: Conquest dilepaskan, True Sight berakhir.

Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge

Saat di True Sight, jika Changli melompat atau menggunakan Basic Attack di udara, ia melepaskan True Sight: Charge, melesat ke arah musuh dan memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG. Setelah True Sight: Charge dilepaskan, True Sight berakhir.

description.en:
Deal Fusion DMG to nearby targets, obtaining 4 stacks of Enflamement, and entering Fiery Feather.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Fiery Feather

When Changli releases Heavy Attack Flaming Sacrifice within 10s, her ATK is increased by 25%, after which Fiery Feather ends.
description.id:
Memberikan Fusion DMG ke target di sekitar, mendapat 4 stack Enflamement, dan memasuki Fiery Feather.
Dapat dilakukan di udara.

Fiery Feather

Saat Changli melepaskan Heavy Attack Flaming Sacrifice dalam 10 dtk, ATK-nya meningkat sebesar 25%, lalu Fiery Feather berakhir.

description.en: When casting Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest or Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge, each stack of Enflamement will increase Fusion DMG Bonus by 5%.
description.id: Saat menggunakan Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest atau Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge, setiap stack Enflamement meningkatkan Fusion DMG Bonus sebesar 5%.

description.en: Casting Heavy Attack Flaming Sacrifice or Resonance Liberation Radiance of Fealty gives 20% Fusion DMG Bonus and ignores 15% of the target's DEF when dealing damage.
description.id: Menggunakan Heavy Attack Flaming Sacrifice atau Resonance Liberation Radiance of Fealty memberi 20% Fusion DMG Bonus dan mengabaikan 15% DEF target saat memberikan damage.

description.en: Changli appears in mid-air, attacks the target, and enters True Sight, lasting for 12s.
description.id: Changli muncul di udara, menyerang target, dan memasuki True Sight selama 12 dtk.

description.en:
Heavy Attack: Flaming Sacrifice

When releasing Heavy Attack, if Changli carries 4 stacks of Enflamement, she consumes all stacks of Enflamement to cast Flaming Sacrifice, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
While casting Flaming Sacrifice, Changli takes 40% less DMG.

Enflamement

Changli can hold up to 4 stacks of Enflamement.
Changli obtains 1 stack of Enflamement for every Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest on hit.
Changli obtains 1 stack of Enflamement for every Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge on hit.
Changli obtains 4 stacks of Enflamement for every Resonance Liberation Radiance of Fealty.
description.id:
Heavy Attack: Flaming Sacrifice

Saat melepaskan Heavy Attack, jika Changli memiliki 4 stack Enflamement, ia mengonsumsi seluruh stack Enflamement untuk melancarkan Flaming Sacrifice, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.
Selama melancarkan Flaming Sacrifice, Changli menerima 40% lebih sedikit DMG.

Enflamement

Changli dapat menyimpan hingga 4 stack Enflamement.
Changli mendapat 1 stack Enflamement untuk setiap Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest yang mengenai target.
Changli mendapat 1 stack Enflamement untuk setiap Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge yang mengenai target.
Changli mendapat 4 stack Enflamement untuk setiap Resonance Liberation Radiance of Fealty.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: The incoming Resonator has their Fusion DMG Amplified by 20% and Resonance Liberation DMG Amplified by 25% for 10s or until the Resonator is switched out.
description.id: Resonator yang masuk mendapat Amplify Fusion DMG sebesar 20% dan Amplify Resonance Liberation DMG sebesar 25% selama 10 dtk atau hingga Resonator tersebut diganti keluar.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melakukan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Resonance Skill Tripartite Flames and Heavy Attack Flaming Sacrifice increase Changli's DMG dealt by 10% and resistance to interruption.
description.id: Resonance Skill Tripartite Flames dan Heavy Attack Flaming Sacrifice meningkatkan DMG yang diberikan Changli sebesar 10% serta ketahanannya terhadap interupsi.

description.en: Enflamement increases Changli's Crit. Rate by 25% for 8s.
description.id: Enflamement meningkatkan Crit. Rate Changli sebesar 25% selama 8 dtk.

description.en: Resonance Liberation Radiance of Fealty DMG is increased by 80%.
description.id: DMG Resonance Liberation Radiance of Fealty meningkat sebesar 80%.

description.en: After Intro Skill is cast, all team members' ATK is increased by 20% for 30s.
description.id: Setelah Intro Skill digunakan, ATK seluruh anggota tim meningkat sebesar 20% selama 30 dtk.

description.en: Heavy Attack Flaming Sacrifice's Multiplier is increased by 50% and its DMG dealt is increased by 50%.
description.id: Pengali Heavy Attack Flaming Sacrifice meningkat sebesar 50% dan DMG yang diberikannya meningkat sebesar 50%.

description.en: Resonance Skill Tripartite Flames, Heavy Attack Flaming Sacrifice, and Resonance Liberation Radiance of Fealty ignore an additional 40% of the target's DEF when dealing damage.
description.id: Resonance Skill Tripartite Flames, Heavy Attack Flaming Sacrifice, dan Resonance Liberation Radiance of Fealty mengabaikan tambahan 40% DEF target saat memberikan damage.
